applicant_utility.summary: This is an award you cannot apply for: international students holding an unconditional offer to the Bachelor of Agricultural Science (or its Honours year) in the Faculty of Science are considered automatically, so the decisive step is securing that offer before the published close date. The $20,000 arrives as two equal instalments after each semester's census date, so budget it as a term-time top-up rather than money you can rely on for tuition, airfares or visa costs. Holding it depends on a 65 semester average every semester and no outstanding fees, and it dies if you switch to domestic status before census or take a larger University-administered award such as the Vice-Chancellor's International Scholarships Scheme.
applicant_utility.best_fit: High-achieving international applicants with strong admissions results who are set on agricultural science at Sydney and can fund the rest of the degree themselves.
application_readiness_checklist: Get the unconditional offer issued before the published close date - a conditional offer is not enough for automatic consideration
Confirm the offer is for the Bachelor of Agricultural Science or its Honours year inside the Faculty of Science, not a similarly named science degree
Check the degree's admission English requirement (University standard: IELTS 6.5 overall, no band below 6.0) and book the test early enough for results to be under two years old at commencement
Do not defer without written permission from the Dean of the Faculty of Science - the scholarship cannot be deferred or transferred by default
Model three years of costs minus $20,000 per year before accepting, since international tuition and living costs sit outside this award
common_rejection_risks: Holding only a conditional offer at the close date, which removes automatic consideration
Falling below a 65 semester average in any semester or carrying outstanding fees
Becoming a domestic student before the semester census date, which terminates the award
Accepting another University-administered scholarship worth AUD 8,300 per year or more for the same purpose, including the VCIS scheme
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: International tuition for the degree plus living, travel and visa costs - the award is a cash payment only and no tuition offset or travel support is published.
document_audit: There is no scholarship form, so every document delay pushes straight into the admission timeline - transcripts and English evidence must ride with the course application
English tests must be under two years old at commencement, and only academic IELTS is accepted
Exchange semesters require a Satisfied Requirements grade before the next instalment is released
alerts: The award is not transferable to another school, faculty or university and cannot be deferred without the Dean's prior permission
Payment lands after each census date, so the first instalment arrives well into the semester - plan cash flow accordingly
Recipients may be invited to promote the degree and represent the University at orientation, marketing and networking events
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Admission application to the University of Sydney - unconditional offer issued - automatic nomination by the Dean of the Faculty of Science - stipend instalments paid after each semester's census date.

official.description: The Melbourne Research Scholarship is offered to high-achieving domestic and international students enrolling in a graduate research degree at the University of Melbourne. It exists as a Fee Offset award, a Stipend award, or a combined Stipend and Fee Offset award providing 100% fee remission and a stipend of $41,100 per year pro rata at the 2027 full-time rate, with around 350 scholarships available.
official.program_type: Graduate research scholarship (Masters by Research and doctoral)
official.english_requirement: Set by each graduate research course and published on the course page; the University's published graduate levels run from IELTS 6.5 with no band below 6.0 up to 7.5, and at-home or online test versions are not accepted. English-taught tertiary study completed within two years of commencement satisfies the requirement without a test; for degrees completed 2-5 years earlier, documented work in an English-speaking environment is required.

applicant_utility.summary: There is no MRS application to lodge: submitting a graduate research course application by that course's closing date puts you into automatic consideration, and Melbourne emails confirmation within seven days. The award that matters is the combined Stipend and Fee Offset package - full fee offset plus a $41,100 per year (2027 rate) fortnightly stipend that can be indexed annually, with relocation money and OSHC for visa-holding internationals. Selection is a ranking across the whole applicant pool on prior academic results and research potential, so what moves you up the list is a supervisor already interested in your project, a research proposal that matches an available project, and clean, verifiable academic records - not a scholarship essay.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Applicants for a PhD or masters by research with strong prior results, a defined project and supervisor interest who want full funding without filing a second application.
application_readiness_checklist: Find your target graduate research course and its closing date on study.unimelb.edu.au - the MRS has no deadline of its own, so the course date is the real deadline
Secure in-principle supervisor agreement before submitting, since most graduate research programs expect it
Check the course page for the specific English level (published levels range from IELTS 6.5 with no band below 6.0 up to 7.5) and sit the test at a centre - at-home versions are rejected

If you are currently enrolled or deferring, check the faculty rules first: Arts, Engineering and Information Technology, and Melbourne Law School do not consider current or deferred candidates, and Science does not consider current candidates
Have transcripts, publications and a referee-ready academic record assembled, since ranking happens on documentary evidence alone
common_rejection_risks: Applying after the course closing date, which removes you from automatic consideration entirely
Being a currently enrolled candidate in a faculty that excludes current students (Arts, Engineering and IT, Law, Science)
A project with no supervisor fit or no in-principle support, which weakens the research-potential ranking
Meeting only the minimum English score where the course publishes a higher level, or submitting an at-home TOEFL/IELTS result
Prior study time counted toward the course, which shortens the scholarship duration
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Living costs beyond the fortnightly stipend, relocation expenses above the $2,000/$3,000 allowance, and any period or course component beyond the maximum fee offset and stipend durations (2 years masters by research; 4 years fee offset and 3.5 years stipend for doctoral candidates).
document_audit: For medium-of-instruction claims from institutions in China, India, Nepal, Pakistan or Saudi Arabia, you need a registrar-issued letter stating the degree (or all degrees) were taught and assessed entirely in English
TOEFL must be the Australia version reported on the 0-120 scale with band scores; select 'Taking TOEFL for Australia' at registration and use institution code 0974
Tests must be sat at a centre, in one sitting, within 24 months of your start date, and in your country of citizenship, last country of education or current country of residence
Academic transcripts must substantiate the prior-study ranking, so gaps or unexplained results invite adverse interpretation
alerts: The stipend is paid fortnightly pro rata - switching to part-time study halves the rate and stretches the duration
Relocation allowance requires you to have been living outside Victoria when you applied and not to have studied at a Victorian institution in the 12 months before applying
Submitting your thesis, withdrawing, or being withdrawn for unsatisfactory progress ends the scholarship and all benefits
Transferring course or changing research project needs prior faculty approval and can shorten rather than extend the award
The University may amend the terms without notice - check the current terms and conditions page before you rely on leave entitlements
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Course application for a graduate research degree by that course's closing date - automatic scholarship consideration - confirmation email within seven days - separate stipend and fee offset offers issued around the time course offers are made.
